name: celgo-policygate
instr:
**edge_access makes different calls than the old gateway checks**

We moved edge_access off our hand-written checks and onto the cel-go policy compiler, and it's been running in shadow next to the old code since yesterday. They disagree on a fair chunk of traffic. Some admins get let into restricted endpoints on 443, which should only ever be reachable on 8443, and a lot of perfectly ordinary calls get denied that the old checks allowed. The policy, our loader and an hour of the shadow log are in /workdir/evidence.

The checkout is in /workdir. Could you track down where this actually goes wrong and fix it
there? Please include a regression test, as a _test.go file in the package it exercises (say
policy/repro_test.go), that fails on the current code because of this problem (a failing
assertion, not an import or build error) and passes once it's fixed. Test the reported behaviour,
not your patch: it should still pass if the bug gets fixed some other correct way, so no asserting
on source text or on helpers only your fix has. It should run on its own from a clean checkout
with just your test files added. It can read files from /workdir/evidence.

Fix it where it starts. Other code goes through the same place and needs to come out right too,
not just the case in this report. Changes to test files and test data aren't part of the fix.
The project's own test suite isn't in this checkout. The full suite runs against your change and
